title: Investigation into Request to Remove Bilingual Signboards at NTU Food Court
what_it_is: Investigation into Request to Remove Bilingual Signboards at NTU Food Court

sections.label: NTU bilingual signboard policy
sections.summary: NTU found a staff member misinterpreted its language policy and required English-only signage, which was not approved; NTU issued a warning and will cover costs to revert signboards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: In all our Autonomous Universities (AUs), there is no issue with display of bilingual signboards, as long as one of the languages used is English, which is the common working language.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: What happened at the Nanyang Technology University (NTU) was, therefore, not in line with the longstanding policy across the AUs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: NTU has investigated the recent incident and found that one of its staff had misinterpreted NTU's language use policy and inserted a requirement that stallholders display English-only signage.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: This was neither approved nor condoned by NTU and its management.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The investigation also concluded that the staff had no ill-intent and a stern warning was issued to this staff member.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: NTU is also working on the panel's recommendations to brief all staff managing its food and beverage and retail outlets on the university's policy on language use, to ensure that it is well understood and also strengthen their ability to balance the NTU community's diverse cultural needs, through training.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: NTU has since also informed all on-campus vendors that non-English languages are permitted on the signboards and notices, as long as English is also used.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: For the vendors which have changed to only English signboards, NTU will cover the expenses to revert to the original signboards.
